horoscope: Mercury, the messenger planet, is now transiting your partnership sector, dear Aries. Until the 30th, you'll have the upper hand in negotiations with the brilliant intelligence of Mercury on your side. But the key is not to score intellectual points now. Instead, your ability to consider the other side of the coin strengthens, which not only helps endear you to others but also lets you enjoy a whole new perspective. Decision-making, however, may not be as easy since you see things from different angles! You seek company for conversations and discussions that ultimately help you reach your own decisions and conclusions. Discussing pros and cons can figure strongly now. It's a superb time for negotiations and compromises. Today, the connections you make or conversations you have can be very revealing and fruitful. Understanding someone close to you can be a welcome relief.

You now have Mercury moving through your work and health sector, dear Taurus, where it will transit until the 30th. This is a time for focusing on procedures and methods, perfecting projects, getting chores done, and organizing your living and working spaces. It's a perfect time to update skills and learn topics that improve your work and health. This is also an active cycle for re-organizing and attending to the details in your daily life. Work or everyday tasks may require close attention to detail and communication. Watch for a tendency to fret during this period, however. Today, you might learn something valuable or meaningful that sets you on a new path. You are determined to make improvements, so take advantage! This is a strong time to make plans and devise strategies. You are willing to do the detailed work involved in moving toward a long-term or ambitious goal.

Mercury is now transiting your solar fifth house, dear Gemini, and until the 30th, this is a good cycle for self-expression, socializing, and spontaneous conversation or learning. Communication flows more easily, with a mental focus on pleasure, fun, romance, entertainment, and creativity. Mercury’s energies here add a stronger desire to make sense of your feelings. You may be analyzing your love life, verbalizing your affections, or pouring more mental energy into games and creative pursuits in the weeks ahead. You are proud of your ideas, and very good at expressing them to others smoothly. Today's energies are excellent for meaningful conversations and gaining important insight into a person or desire. Communications are in great shape right now. Your communications, studies, creative work, and possibly a romantic involvement have more depth, intensity, and sincerity.

Mercury is now transiting your sector of heart, home, and family, dear Cancer. Until the 30th, things may be particularly busy at home or with family, and some of you will be doing quite a bit of work or study at home during this period. You may learn valuable lessons through contact with family, or about family. There can be considerably more than the usual preoccupation with personal and domestic matters now and in the weeks ahead. Today, your communications and thoughts carry more power and passion, as you're not content to scratch the surface of an issue, you want to get to the bottom of it! You are inclined to investigate, poke, and prod until you feel comfortable that you know enough. New strategies and developments in your personal or family life can be beneficial, and conversations can be helpful and revealing. Good news about a financial matter can arise.

Mercury, the messenger planet, is now transiting your communications sector, dear Leo, and this boosts and speeds up your daily affairs until the 30th. This is a pleasant position for Mercury and can feel like a breath of fresh air, although there can be times when it's difficult to concentrate. This is a good cycle for detail work, easy and pleasant communication, and generating new ideas or developing new interests. Learning, speaking, writing, and transportation matters are in focus and in good shape. You also enjoy taking in information and relaying it. Today, transits help you to get to the bottom of a problem or situation. Deep subjects and previously hidden information can come to light now. This is a time for holding onto a topic until you've gathered more info or devised a good strategy. Conversations, observations, and musings can lead to important insight into a person in your life, a relationship, or a project. You might bond with a special person through an intimate conversation.

Mercury is now transiting your solar second house, dear Virgo, and influences this sector of your chart until the 30th. Mercury in your sign over the past several weeks has helped you sort things out and clarify your mental priorities. Now, you're more preoccupied with practical affairs and looking to build and see tangible results from your efforts. It's a great time to think about improvements to business pursuits and organize your finances. As the day goes on, you're focused, and priorities are easy to identify. You're likely to enjoy a pleasant intensity that benefits you most in practical ways, especially around money, work, health, and habits. Thinking a little more deeply about these matters can lead to useful strategies and insight. Good energy is with you for concentrating and focusing on those things that matter when it comes to improving or securing your future. You're not content to only skim the surface of a topic now, making it a solid time to get to the bottom of things or tighten the details of a plan.

Mercury is now in your sign, dear Libra, where this planet of communications will transit until the 30th. The cycle ahead is busy, especially engaging, and keeps you on your toes. Your words have more impact and decisions come more readily and spontaneously now. With Mercury in your corner, you can enjoy improved decision-making, more alertness and curiosity, and a greater ability to talk about your plans. Others are listening! Of course, with others listening so attentively, you might decide to be more careful with your communications. Today, transits strengthen your determination, resolve, and concentration, putting you in an advantageous position with creative projects, personal appeal, romance, or children. It can also be a time for gathering important information. A conversation, thought process, or journal entry could help you release recent mental tension.

Mercury is now transiting your privacy sector, dear Scorpio, and will be its guest until the 30th. This transit closes up a communications cycle, and it makes a lot of sense to review, assess, or reassess recent projects, interests, and studies. It's also a good time for tying up loose ends on a project or study or for wrapping up a project. You might often look back for answers during this cycle, and you might take extra time for contemplation, meditation, research, and behind-the-scenes study or work. Decision-making can be a longer, more careful process during this cycle. Today, you're in a great position to see what others are overlooking, and you're in a healthy place emotionally. The best way to truly process and digest recent experiences is through some form of relaxation or retreat, as you may need to step back from situations to see the whole story. It would benefit you greatly to focus on what you can get rid of to simplify and improve your life going forward, including attitudes or habits. Listen to family members who have something valuable or meaningful to say, or to your intuition about your personal life. Supporting others can be rewarding.

Mercury is now transiting your solar eleventh house until the 30th, dear Sagittarius, and this can take some of the recent pressure off to perform and also improve your social skills. It can be a strong time for inventive new ideas, sharing ideas with others, and successful (or at least happy) networking. Valuable learning experiences can result from your association with friends, associates, or groups. Today is strong for communications. You can be well-positioned to persuade, share, and connect. Learning flows well. There can be a moment of truth or new insight into a friendship today, and connections you make now can be very fruitful. Conversations are a little more serious, but also more useful. You may be doing some guiding or teaching now.

Mercury is now moving through your career and reputation sector, dear Capricorn, where it will transit until the 30th. This is a period for taking care of business, showing off your skills or getting attention for your abilities, and for packing a stronger punch in your communications. You may be a little more guarded about expressing yourself, however, as you sense that others are really taking notice of what you're communicating, and they probably are! This influence brings much interest and thought to career and business matters, and your career may demand more of your communication skills. Today, you're likely to feel a gentle wave of certainty and determination come over you. You're in a great position to concentrate on your priorities or to come to a useful conclusion about a career or money matter. This can also be a time for meaningful conversations and positive word of mouth.

Mercury is now making its way through your adventure sector, dear Aquarius, where it will transit until the 30th. This is a good cycle for communications and broad thinking. You feel a little more hopeful and optimistic than usual, and you're especially spontaneous and free with your ideas. You might discover a new interest, or you could be pursuing a particular topic with more vigor during this cycle. Today, transits enhance your persuasive abilities and conjure up good energy for reading, listening, conversing, learning, and absorbing valuable information. You may feel inspired by an idea, gain a new understanding of a situation, or learn something that excites you and positively impacts future projects. You're in an excellent position to promote, publish, learn, travel, or present your ideas now.

Mercury is now transiting your shared resources sector, dear Pisces, where it will visit until the 30th. During this cycle, you're inclined to read between the lines and strategize more often. You may be doing some valuable research or investigation. This is a good time for bringing more common sense to finances. It's also strong for deep, interesting conversations with others and for self-discovery. Today, the idea of making big or long-lasting changes is very appealing. You're in good shape for instinctively zeroing in on the information you need. Conversations and connections are likely to work in your favor. Your willingness to see things differently opens you up to new insight, and this can be a particularly good time to make lifestyle or financial changes.
